title: A dispatched worker's session leaves work rows land can attribute, so cost reads every item of a sprint
goal: Every worker that backlog.py dispatch starts leaves a branch, agent-start or agent-stop row naming its item in the clone's query log spool, and land names why when none exists; a claim the orchestrator works in its own session likewise leaves a work row land and cost can attribute, or land names why

clauses.clause: Every worker that backlog.py dispatch starts leaves a branch, agent-start or agent-stop row naming its item in the clone's query log spool
land names why when none exists
a claim the orchestrator works in its own session likewise leaves a work row land and cost can attribute, or land names why

gates.question: How does a worker that dispatch starts get its work rows to the spool land and cost read: dispatch hands the worker the spool location, or dispatch only records the worker's session and names where its rows went when none arrived?
options: hand the worker the spool location
record the session and name where the rows went
gates.recommendation: record the session and name where the rows went
gates.answer: record the session and name where the rows went

notes: Retrospective of SP-htl7jkrm: ST-ksgrpumr's land warned 'landed with no work rows (missing): no worker session of it left a branch, agent-start or agent-stop row' while its siblings dispatched the same way showed late rows; ST-65r3cwix landed with its work sidecar undelivered; cost --rework SP-htl7jkrm read 0 runs at review time. Recurred in SP-tcis5f23 (2026-10-13): cost --rework at the close read 0 runs and only the orchestrator's open session; worker spend from their result.json: research 2.20 USD, seven bugs 0.33-0.66 USD each, reviewer 1.64 USD. Absorbs ST-t5z6vddy (2026-10-13 triage): BG-pzgeq5t4 and BG-tyh3t5oj, worked in the orchestrator's own session, landed with 'no work rows (missing)' (goal clause 3); add _tools/ql_capture.py, _tools/bl_cost.py or kb/_self/usage.md to a task's touches only if the fix needs them. Premise (planner, 2026-10-13): backlog.py cost --rework SP-tcis5f23 now reads 8 items with sonnet rows, so the rows came late or elsewhere, not never; land's 'missing' line only guesses 'a worker started without the capture hooks?', so clause 2 (name why) stays unmet. Planned at the 2026-10-13 draft triage (sprint 11 of 15, "Worker runs are counted: work and usage rows reach cost, dispatch is safe in parallel, staged copies come back by tool"): it fixes a failure that recurred in recent sprints and blocks the EP-gzr4mmkm fitness test that a content sprint lands on headless Sonnet workers with no operator step beyond its gates.
